{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_only = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

print(f'Treatment arm patient count: {len(treatment_only)}')
print(f'Fraction responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}')"}
